newsitem.title: CANADA: Shell Canada to integrate downstream.
newsitem.headline: Shell Canada to integrate downstream.

text.p: Shell Canada Ltd said on Wednesday it would integrate the businesses of its three private-brand gasoline marketing subsidiaries and would take a C$50 million after-tax charge in the fourth quarter from the move.
Shell Canada said the integration of Canadian Turbo (1993) Ltd, Pay Less Gas Co and Beaver Fuels Management Ltd into its own network would eliminate dublication and create efficencies.
The company said it was expected that most of the private brands employees would be offered employment with Shell Canada.
The C$50-million provision would reflect asset rationalization and environmental cleanup charges, Shell Canada said.
